_meta.description: Wallets of exchanges FIU-IND acted against (data/fiu_ind_status.json) that had no wallet in the label files, so their FIU-IND note could never appear on a trace. Batch 1: BingX, LBank, XT.com, Phemex and Bitrue. Batch 2: MoonPay, WOO X, Paxful, ProBit Global, LCX and CEX.IO. Batch 3: YouHodler, Changelly, Mercuryo and Beldex. Every row is also in that chain's exchange label file (config.Chain.labels_path) as {exchange, label, type}, which is what the matcher reads; this file records where each came from.
_meta.provenance: The explorer's own public name tag on the address page (etherscan.io/address/<a>, polygonscan.com/address/<a>), read from the page title without an API key, as data/india_exchanges.json round 1 reads it; source_date is the page's own 'As at' time and retrieved_on the UTC day it was read (15 Nov 2026 UTC, 16 Nov IST). Candidate addresses came from dawsbot/eth-labels @ 14247ba8cf4686b747938248bee34c66089fa9d9 (data/csv/accounts.csv, tags whose head names one of the exchanges of that batch); a candidate became a row only if the explorer page for that chain carries a tag that app/tron_tags.exchange_for_tag reads as that exchange and that is not infrastructure. The label is the tag as the page shows it.
_meta.first_party_sources: No list of its own wallets from any of the five could be read without a browser on 15 Nov 2026: Phemex's proof-of-reserves page (phemex.com/proof-of-reserves) loads its data in the browser only; BingX's public proof-of-reserves repository (github.com/BingX-API/BingX-proof-of-reserves) holds a Merkle-tree verifier, not addresses; no LBank, XT.com or Bitrue wallet list was found (Bitrue's and XT.com's proof-of-reserves URLs answer 404). No government or court document naming a wallet of any of the five was found. Batch 2 (15 Nov 2026 UTC): no wallet list of its own from MoonPay, WOO X, Paxful, ProBit Global, LCX or CEX.IO was read; none was found that loads without a browser. Batch 3 (15 Nov 2026 UTC): no wallet list of its own from YouHodler, Changelly, Mercuryo or Beldex was read.
_meta.not_done: No ownership was inferred: no clustering, no guessing, no address from a listing site alone. BscScan and Arbiscan pages sit behind a bot check and were not read, so nothing was added on BNB Smart Chain or Arbitrum; nothing was added on Tron. Per-customer deposit addresses ('X Dep') were not taken.
_meta.activity: Every row's explorer page showed at least one transaction on that chain. Each address was also read on 15 Nov 2026 (UTC) through keyless public RPCs (ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com, polygon-bor-rpc.publicnode.com): none holds contract code, except XT.com: Hot Wallet (0xefda0cb7...), whose code is an EIP-7702 delegation (0xef0100 + a delegate address), so it is still an account and is typed exchange_wallet. Batch 2, read the same way on 15 Nov 2026 (UTC): none holds contract code, except MoonPay 7 (0x7afc12c8...) and LCX 1 (0xc0c704bf...), whose code is an EIP-7702 delegation, so they are accounts and typed exchange_wallet; Woo X 4 (0xea319fd7...), a Gnosis Safe proxy, was not taken. Batch 3, read the same way on 15 Nov 2026 (UTC): none of the five addresses taken holds contract code on either chain; every BitGo candidate holds contract code on Ethereum and none was taken.
_meta.collisions: Checked against every list in backend/data (exchange, India set, risk, sanctions, frozen, threat, gambling, router, privacy, mixer, never-flag), the recorded demos and tests, and the label store of release labels-2026-11-16: no address was already labelled; the one a demo names is left out. Batch 2 was checked the same way, and against the laundering-heuristic validation corpus (data/validation/corpus.json): the one a demo names and the one the corpus uses as a control are left out. Batch 3 was checked the same way, including the validation corpus and the label store of release labels-2026-11-16 (labels, exchange_rows, exchange_deposits): none of the five addresses taken was in any of them; of those left out, one BitGo contract (0x03237183...) is a statement counterparty in a recorded demo.
